description: Proposes boundary adjustments and rezoning for Dream Asset Management.
Rezones 2.92 acres north of Carright Street to light industrial.
Removes holding symbol, allowing future industrial development.
Adjusts hotel site and flex zone boundaries.

chips.text: 73 residents attended a public meeting; no concerns raised about the application.

description: Approves a car wash and retail units at 210 Orban Way.
Car wash reclaims 60% of water using a filtration system.

chips.text: Councillor asked about noise mitigation; building uses concrete and insulation.
Residents within 150 meters of 210 Orban Way received public notice.
Car wash reclaims 60% of water using a 14,000-gallon filtration system.

description: Approves a goaltending school at 115 Radu Crescent.
Limits school to two students and two instructors.

chips.text: Applicant clarified school operates 30-45 minute sessions, busiest 3-8 PM, not constant traffic.
The commercial school operates in the Marcus Industrial Neighborhood.

description: Vice-Chair updated on zoning amendment for 335 Avenue South.
Amendment allows daycare uses at former church.

chips.text: Property owner at 335 Avenue South affected by zoning amendment.
No opposition was reported regarding the zoning amendment at the public hearing.
